# LeadMagic Skills & Plugin

> Official agent skills and Claude Code plugin for the LeadMagic B2B enrichment API — every public endpoint, credit costs, plan-aware guidance, bulk CSV jobs, hosted MCP, and outbound-system recipes. REST base: https://api.leadmagic.io (header `X-API-Key`). Hosted MCP: https://mcp.leadmagic.io/mcp (OAuth).

## Start here

- [Router skill](skills/leadmagic/SKILL.md): safety rules, product-picking heuristics, skill map
- [Complete endpoint reference](skills/leadmagic/references/leadmagic-api-quickref.md): every endpoint with credit cost, rate limit, and aliases
- [Plans & limits](skills/leadmagic/references/plans-and-limits.md): plan ladder, Search API entitlements, budgeting, 402/429 playbook
- [Outbound recipes](skills/leadmagic/references/outbound-recipes.md): 13 composable recipes with cost models

## Skills

- [api-auth-credits](skills/api-auth-credits/SKILL.md): keys, credits, plans, error codes
- [email-enrichment](skills/email-enrichment/SKILL.md): find/validate email, B2B Profile ↔ email
- [people-search](skills/people-search/SKILL.md): POST /v3/people/search + variants
- [people-enrichment](skills/people-enrichment/SKILL.md): profile, mobile, role, employees, job change
- [company-enrichment](skills/company-enrichment/SKILL.md): company, funding, technographics, competitors
- [company-search](skills/company-search/SKILL.md): POST /v3/companies/search (account lists / TAM)
- [job-search](skills/job-search/SKILL.md): POST /v3/jobs/search (postings; vector/facets/deep)
- [jobs-hiring-intent](skills/jobs-hiring-intent/SKILL.md): hiring signals, intent lenses, bulk sweeps
- [ads-intelligence](skills/ads-intelligence/SKILL.md): Google/Meta/B2B ads research
- [bulk-jobs](skills/bulk-jobs/SKILL.md): /bulk/* CSV and list enrichment
- [analytics-observability](skills/analytics-observability/SKILL.md): free usage and spend reporting
- [outbound-recipes](skills/outbound-recipes/SKILL.md): recipe index and operating rules
- [mcp-integration](skills/mcp-integration/SKILL.md): hosted MCP setup and tool→REST map
